test_title: PYST 4: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mountains are lakes.

Some lakes are fountains.

All fountains are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are lakes.

II. Some cars are mountains.

III. Some fountains are mountains.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b612e05773f97ecfe023d950b16407c0d9c89c6521d2635bfeb5b81e3489b8b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cars are lakes → **True **(As, Some mountains are lakes, All fountains are cars. so, Some cars are lakes holds true)

II. Some cars are mountains → False (As, there is no direct relation between cars and mountains. So, it can be a possibility, but not definite)

III. Some fountains are mountains → False (As, there is no direct relation between fountains and mountains. So, it can be a possibility, but not definite).

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
